description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of topics within a dataset. The chart contains five slices, representing the categories “Common,” “Person,” “Book,” “Sport,” and “Topics.” The slice labeled “Topics” is light blue and occupies approximately 41.2% of the chart, while “Common” is a pale gray and represents about 30.5%. The “Person” category is colored light coral and accounts for roughly 9.1% of the chart, followed by “Book” in light green at approximately 14.9%. Finally, “Sport” is represented by a light salmon color and comprises about 4.3% of the total. A legend is present, labeling each slice with its corresponding category. Percentage labels are displayed within each slice. The slices appear to be arranged in a clockwise order, with the largest slice at the top and decreasing in size as they proceed around the circle.
